1968-160.13.statement: For a skew-symmetric \(2m\times2m\) matrix over a field of characteristic different from two, \(\det A=\operatorname{Pf}(A)^2\). The Pfaffian is the signed sum \[\operatorname{Pf}(A)=\sum_\pi\operatorname{sgn}(\pi)\prod_{j=1}^m a_{\pi(2j-1),\pi(2j)}.\] Here the sum runs over permutations satisfying \(\pi(2j-1)<\pi(2j)\) and \(\pi(1)<\pi(3)<\cdots<\pi(2m-1)\); these index unordered pairings without division. In characteristic zero this also equals the sum over all permutations divided by \(2^m m!\), and its exterior-form description is \(\omega^m=m!\operatorname{Pf}(A)\,dx_1\wedge\cdots\wedge dx_{2m}\). Odd skew determinants vanish.

1967-140.6.fate: This repeats 1966-94.4 and reuses GP-1966-01. \citet[Conjecture 2.3 and Theorem 2.4]{spatzier2016rigidity} states the precise conjecture and the Franks--Manning result on infranilmanifolds. \citet[\S1, Background]{damjanovic2026symmetries} still describes algebraicity of general Anosov dynamics as conjectural. Sinai's two-torus case appears as Theorem 5.2 of \citet{sinai1968markov}.

1967-142.3.present_status: As of November 2026, the notebook does not determine a unique algebraic/topological category for this axiomatization request. The stated universal Radon-representation property is an explicit editorial comparison problem; the checked nuclear and cylinder-measure results do not certify that it is a recognized unresolved conjecture. No precise open problem is inferred from this occurrence.

GP-1966-01.status: As of November 2026, the general conjecture remains open. The known infranilmanifold case is the Franks--Manning theorem; the two-torus case is proved in \citet[Theorem5.2]{sinai1968markov}. See the precise conjecture and known case in \citet[Conjecture2.3, Theorem2.4]{spatzier2016rigidity} and its still-conjectural status in \citet[\S1, Background]{damjanovic2026symmetries}.
